 My machine: outputs <code>In the thread</code> <em>about 4% of the time</em>. <br> What happened?

### a race  {.smaller}



* returning from main <em>exits the entire process</em> (all its threads) 
   * same as calling exit; not like other threads
* race: main's return 0 or print_message's printf first?

![](/threads/texfig/pthreadCreateRace.figure.svg){fig-alt="Diagram showing: main runs doing printf/pthread_create/printf/return; in the middle of that print_message starts to do printf/return. print_message is cut off whereever main stops, possibly in the middle of its work."}
